entities.name: Sharae of Numbing Depths
entities.description: Undine wizard of Eldraine and leader of the merfolk of Loch Larent, with golden scales and a split tail.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: Lake of Sharae's merfolk, frozen over by Hylda.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: Ice-wielder who formed the icy castle of Winter's Home and later gave up her ice crown.

entities.name: Merfolk of Loch Larent
entities.description: People led by Sharae, trapped under the frozen lake.

events.summary: Sharae and her people are trapped under the frozen lake when Hylda forms the icy castle of Winter's Home.
events.quote: Sharae and her people were trapped under the frozen surface of the lake when Hylda formed the icy castle of Winter's Home

events.summary: The merfolk are presumably freed when Hylda's powers wane after she gives up her ice crown.
events.quote: The merfolk were presumably freed when Hylda's powers waned after she gave up her ice crown

relations.quote: Sharae is the leader of the merfolk of Loch Larent
